name: Citadel: Barracks
summary: The Muramite military barracks and training yards within the Citadel Complex.
description: Citadel Barracks houses Muramite soldiers, elite legionnaires, beast‑handlers, and tactical trainees. Training yards, supply corridors, reinforced bunkhouses, and Discord‑infused drill chambers fill the area. Officers oversee drills, discipline, and readiness for deployment deeper into the Citadel. Resistance infiltrators rarely reach this zone, but sabotage attempts and intelligence theft occasionally occur. Discord energy subtly enhances Muramite strength and aggression.
